questions.question: What is the urgent plea of Psalm 70?
options: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not!
Have mercy on me, O God, for I have sinned!
Make haste, O God, to deliver me!
Sing to the LORD a new song of praise!
questions.answer: Make haste, O God, to deliver me!

questions.question: What does David ask for those who seek God?
options: That they remain silent before him
That they scatter and flee far away
That they rejoice and be glad in God
That they be put to shame and turn back
questions.answer: That they rejoice and be glad in God

questions.question: David calls himself poor and needy and asks God to hasten to him.
Make haste to help me, O LORD! ... O LORD, do not _____!
May those who love your salvation always say, 'Let God be _____!'
